review_kind: Independent read-only source, contract, completed focused-run and coverage review; the reviewer did not execute product code or tests.

temporal_scope.meaning: This archives the previously provided source-and-coverage conclusions. Its acceptance covers the exact source patch and completed scoped runs described below. It does not incorporate or endorse the subsequently completed full default-driver result; that result and its construction failure are reviewed separately.

source.recovery_qualification: The six-file patch was transcribed from complete previously observed tool output after the earlier workspace became inaccessible. The new commit's full tree matches the observed unpublished 66fc501 tree. The vanished raw commit object and execution logs were not recovered or recreated.

contract_findings.finding: The exact endpoint traversal is selected directly for its traversal/cancellation tests. The P01 comparison disables the separate component-reduction selector in both arms, requires positive and equal group/scalar traversal calls, and retains complete GLB and full report equality. Cancellation still occurs at callback 83, preserves the thrown marker and work.callback_error identity, and leaves input tracks unchanged. The separate dispatcher remains exercised by endpoint-reduction tests.

The ordinary control reconstructs the public snapshot after discarding actual pending output instead of replacing _validate_staged. Both arms retain equal native storage/function receipts, apart from their different class-owner field, and equal complete output observations. The test requires actual discarded pending output, lower reused work, positive and equal release capture/anchor-publication counts, and CellAnchor proofs in both arms. Existing alias, transfer-once, mismatch, budget and cancellation assertions remain.

Changed-operand comparisons remove the inapplicable CellAnchor proof from both synthetic states, retain exact work-increment expectations and cached-versus-forced-recomputation equality, and separately require rejection of a retained stale CellAnchor with the reach_domain changed-source diagnostic. Stale-proof rejection preserves the original state/proof and prevents publication. Owner-reference deepcopy preserves owner identity; it does not itself grant proof authority.

Both comparison arms disable the later forward-translation selection. Assertions identify the actual native/ordinary _rotated_offset implementation, require positive invocations and equal non-multiplication charges, and reconcile all savings to multiplication work. Frame bits, enclosures, source state and delivered bytes remain checked.

Both arms disable later centered-endpoint and native-composition selection, require actual nonzero invocation of the intended rotation kernel, and retain complete GLB equality, independent validation and work assertions.
Both arms disable the later centered-endpoint path so the intended head cursor actually advances; supplied-byte equality and original limit assertions remain.

Both arms disable the later centered-endpoint path. Equal composition counts and positive actual composition across the corpus prevent a vacuous comparison; complete bytes, validation and positive aggregate savings remain checked. The broad P11 graph is not falsely required to select the sequential path.

Both arms disable the later centered-endpoint path, require positive sparse-product use and equal Hamilton call counts, retain complete bytes and validation equality, and reconcile work savings to the observed product operations.

Both arms disable the later Cartesian producer capture. Tests require captured phases, the ordinary Y head with the captured Z path, false Cartesian selectors, completed phases and positive rotation steps, while preserving complete GLB equality, lower product work and original limits.

later_failure_reproductions.meaning: All six failures reproduce at the same unchanged assertion sites. Two numerical failure strings differ between source cuts and remain distinct evidence. Reproduction is attribution evidence, not a passing regression claim.
